headline: Coral Reef rises on the GPU
lede: The dead reef draft is a shipping raymarcher: light shafts, a caustic web on gold sand, and a boids school that finally shows up on camera — with the physics bugs (flipped Beer–Lambert, squashed fish, a speed sensor that always read zero) fixed under it.

notes.text: #1050 CORAL REEF GPU shipped — 36-gate reefcheck, mutant-proven caustic-web gate (463px clean vs 167 mutant).
Absorption must apply only to transmitted surface light; fog in-scatter is added after. Getting the order wrong grays out the whole sea.
A perf metric that never moves (fence busy=0ms) is a broken sensor, not a fast GPU — the adaptive quality ladder was silently dead.
#1093 QA polish pass filed: coral surface relief, ray wash, horizon haze, fish silhouette variety.

look.text: Fly the reef: drag to look, tap for shrimp crackles
